figure: Fig. 1 - study-area location map, IJWF package
source: copy of paper/figures/fig1_study_map.py with the same data and asserts
ijwf_changes: part labels and titles of (b) 8 pt; map labels (9 pt in the shared figure), graticule labels, scale bars and keys 7 pt; sentence case in the two keys (Study area, Gate control, not modelled, Burned, Within 10 km, Beyond 10 km, Not modelled); labels of (a) placed again, see label_placement

label_placement.rule: gaps between bounding boxes in points, asserted at build time: 1.5 to 15 pt to the own marker, every other marker at least 9 pt and two and a half times as far away, key and scale bar at least 6 pt away, any two texts at least 6 pt apart (layout check)

aoi_data.note: step0 geojson / 30m-grid-derived; sha256 per source inside

basemap.fetched_via: cartopy 0.25.0 downloader; files read from the cartopy cache
basemap.note: Natural Earth is public domain; version as shipped by NACIS CDN on the download date below (the cache files carry no version string)

reproducibility: Drawn for the IJWF package on 2026-11-11 in a separate environment with cartopy (the project environments have none), from the Natural Earth files of the cartopy cache. same_files_as_shared_figure compares their sha256 with those in paper/figures/fig1_provenance.json. The history of the shared render is recorded there and is not repeated here.
asserts: all five AOI bboxes match Table S13 to 5e-3 deg; panel (b) cells, burned cells and the share beyond 10 km match Table 1
design: 2026-10-23 redraw: one blue dot per study area (no regime grouping implied); no topography/satellite; Kozan 2023 as an open grey square with its own key entry, so its location is findable from the gate section without implying it entered any model; 170 mm wide (SpringerOpen full page width), key inside the graphic
kozan_bbox_source: drive_new/kozan-legacy/step8a/step8a_dataset_stats.json (30 m reference-grid transform); cross-checked in-script against the independent step2b_dem_metadata.json AOI polygon to 5e-3 deg
palette: Okabe-Ito blue (study) / neutral grey (control) on very light neutral land; greyscale-safe
